38.text: And Jesus having turned, and having beheld them following, saith to them, 'What seek ye?' and they said to them, 'Rabbi, (which is, being interpreted, Teacher,) where remainest thou?'

39.text: He saith to them, 'Come and see;' they came, and saw where he doth remain, and with him they remained that day and the hour was about the tenth.

42.text: and he brought him unto Jesus: and having looked upon him, Jesus saith, 'Thou art Simon, the son of Jonas, thou shalt be called Cephas,' (which is interpreted, A rock.)

43.text: On the morrow, he willed to go forth to Galilee, and he findeth Philip, and saith to him, 'Be following me.'

47.text: Jesus saw Nathanael coming unto him, and he saith concerning him, 'Lo, truly an Israelite, in whom guile is not;'

48.text: Nathanael saith to him, 'Whence me dost thou know?' Jesus answered and said to him, 'Before Philip's calling thee — thou being under the fig-tree — I saw thee.'

50.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Because I said to thee, I saw thee under the fig-tree, thou dost believe; greater things than these thou shalt see;'

51.text: and he saith to him, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, henceforth ye shall see the heaven opened, and the messengers of God going up and coming down upon the Son of Man.'

4.text: Jesus saith to her, 'What — to me and to thee, woman? not yet is mine hour come.'

7.text: Jesus saith to them, 'Fill the water-jugs with water;' and they filled them — unto the brim;

8.text: and he saith to them, 'Draw out, now, and bear to the director of the apartment;' and they bare.

16.text: and to those selling the doves he said, 'Take these things hence; make not the house of my Father a house of merchandise.'

19.text: Jesus answered and said to them, 'Destroy this sanctuary, and in three days I will raise it up.'

3.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Verily, verily, I say to thee, If any one may not be born from above, he is not able to see the reign of God;'

5.text: Jesus answered, 'Verily, verily, I say to thee, If any one may not be born of water, and the Spirit, he is not able to enter into the reign of God;

6.text: that which hath been born of the flesh is flesh, and that which hath been born of the Spirit is spirit.

7.text: 'Thou mayest not wonder that I said to thee, It behoveth you to be born from above;

8.text: the Spirit where he willeth doth blow, and his voice thou dost hear, but thou hast not known whence he cometh, and whither he goeth; thus is every one who hath been born of the Spirit.'

10.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'Thou art the teacher of Israel — and these things thou dost not know!

11.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to thee — What we have known we speak, and what we have seen we testify, and our testimony ye do not receive;

12.text: if the earthly things I said to you, and ye do not believe, how, if I shall say to you the heavenly things, will ye believe?

13.text: and no one hath gone up to the heaven, except he who out of the heaven came down — the Son of Man who is in the heaven.

14.text: 'And as Moses did lift up the serpent in the wilderness, so it behoveth the Son of Man to be lifted up,

15.text: that every one who is believing in him may not perish, but may have life age-during,

16.text: for God did so love the world, that His Son — the only begotten — He gave, that every one who is believing in him may not perish, but may have life age-during.

17.text: For God did not send His Son to the world that he may judge the world, but that the world may be saved through him;

18.text: he who is believing in him is not judged, but he who is not believing hath been judged already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.

19.text: 'And this is the judgment, that the light hath come to the world, and men did love the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil;

20.text: for every one who is doing wicked things hateth the light, and doth not come unto the light, that his works may not be detected;

21.text: but he who is doing the truth doth come to the light, that his works may be manifested, that in God they are having been wrought.'

7.text: there cometh a woman out of Samaria to draw water. Jesus saith to her, 'Give me to drink;'

10.text: Jesus answered and said to her, 'If thou hadst known the gift of God, and who it is who is saying to thee, Give me to drink, thou wouldest have asked him, and he would have given thee living water.'

13.text: Jesus answered and said to her, 'Every one who is drinking of this water shall thirst again;

14.text: but whoever may drink of the water that I will give him, may not thirst — to the age; and the water that I will give him shall become in him a well of water, springing up to life age-during.'

16.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Go, call thy husband, and come hither;'

17.text: the woman answered and said, 'I have not a husband.' Jesus saith to her, 'Well didst thou say — A husband I have not;

18.text: for five husbands thou hast had, and, now, he whom thou hast is not thy husband; this hast thou said truly.'

21.text: Jesus saith to her, 'Woman, believe me, that there doth come an hour, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, shall ye worship the Father;

22.text: ye worship what ye have not known; we worship what we have known, because the salvation is of the Jews;

23.text: but, there cometh an hour, and it now is, when the true worshippers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father also doth seek such to worship him;

24.text: God [is] a Spirit, and those worshipping Him, in spirit and truth it doth behove to worship.'

26.text: Jesus saith to her, 'I am [he], who am speaking to thee.'

32.text: and he said to them, 'I have food to eat that ye have not known.'

34.text: Jesus saith to them, 'My food is, that I may do the will of Him who sent me, and may finish His work;

35.text: do not say that it is yet four months, and the harvest cometh; lo, I say to you, Lift up your eyes, and see the fields, that they are white unto harvest already.

36.text: 'And he who is reaping doth receive a reward, and doth gather fruit to life age-during, that both he who is sowing and he who is reaping may rejoice together;

37.text: for in this the saying is the true one, that one is the sower and another the reaper.

38.text: I sent you to reap that on which ye have not laboured; others laboured, and ye into their labour have entered.

48.text: Jesus then said unto him, 'If signs and wonders ye may not see, ye will not believe.'

50.text: Jesus saith to him, 'Be going on; thy son doth live.' And the man believed the word that Jesus said to him, and was going on,

53.text: then the father knew that [it was] in that hour in which Jesus said to him — 'Thy son doth live,' and he himself believed, and his whole house;

6.text: him Jesus having seen lying, and having known that he is already a long time, he saith to him, 'Dost thou wish to become whole?'

8.text: Jesus saith to him, 'Rise, take up thy couch, and be walking;'

14.text: After these things, Jesus findeth him in the temple, and said to him, 'Lo, thou hast become whole; sin no more, lest something worse may happen to thee.'

17.text: And Jesus answered them, 'My Father till now doth work, and I work;'

19.text: Jesus therefore responded and said to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, The Son is not able to do anything of himself, if he may not see the Father doing anything; for whatever things He may do, these also the Son in like manner doth;

20.text: for the Father doth love the Son, and doth shew to him all things that He himself doth; and greater works than these He will shew him, that ye may wonder.

21.text: 'For, as the Father doth raise the dead, and doth make alive, so also the Son doth make alive whom he willeth;

22.text: for neither doth the Father judge any one, but all the judgment He hath given to the Son,

23.text: that all may honour the Son according as they honour the Father; he who is not honouring the Son, doth not honour the Father who sent him.

24.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you — He who is hearing my word, and is believing Him who sent me, hath life age-during, and to judgment he doth not come, but hath passed out of the death to the life.

25.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you — There cometh an hour, and it now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God, and those having heard shall live;

26.text: for, as the Father hath life in himself, so He gave also to the Son to have life in himself,

27.text: and authority He gave him also to do judgment, because he is Son of Man.

28.text: 'Wonder not at this, because there doth come an hour in which all those in the tombs shall hear his voice,

29.text: and they shall come forth; those who did the good things to a rising again of life, and those who practised the evil things to a rising again of judgment.

30.text: 'I am not able of myself to do anything; according as I hear I judge, and my judgment is righteous, because I seek not my own will, but the will of the Father who sent me.

31.text: 'If I testify concerning myself, my testimony is not true;

32.text: another there is who is testifying concerning me, and I have known that the testimony that he doth testify concerning me is true;

33.text: ye have sent unto John, and he hath testified to the truth.

34.text: 'But I do not receive testimony from man, but these things I say that ye may be saved;

35.text: he was the burning and shining lamp, and ye did will to be glad, for an hour, in his light.

36.text: 'But I have the testimony greater than John's, for the works that the Father gave me, that I might finish them, the works themselves that I do, they testify concerning me, that the Father hath sent me.

37.text: 'And the Father who sent me Himself hath testified concerning me; ye have neither heard His voice at any time, nor His appearance have ye seen;

38.text: and His word ye have not remaining in you, because whom He sent, him ye do not believe.

39.text: 'Ye search the Writings, because ye think in them to have life age-during, and these are they that are testifying concerning me;

40.text: and ye do not will to come unto me, that ye may have life;

41.text: glory from man I do not receive,

42.text: but I have known you, that the love of God ye have not in yourselves.

43.text: 'I have come in the name of my Father, and ye do not receive me; if another may come in his own name, him ye will receive;

44.text: how are ye able — ye — to believe, glory from one another receiving, and the glory that [is] from God alone ye seek not?

45.text: 'Do not think that I will accuse you unto the Father; there is who is accusing you, Moses — in whom ye have hoped;

46.text: for if ye were believing Moses, ye would have been believing me, for he wrote concerning me;

47.text: but if his writings ye believe not, how shall ye believe my sayings?'

5.text: Jesus then having lifted up [his] eyes and having seen that a great multitude doth come to him, saith unto Philip, 'Whence shall we buy loaves, that these may eat?' —

10.text: And Jesus said, 'Make the men to sit down;' and there was much grass in the place, the men then sat down, in number, as it were, five thousand,

12.text: And when they were filled, he saith to his disciples, 'Gather together the broken pieces that are over, that nothing may be lost;'

20.text: and he saith to them, 'I am [he], be not afraid;'

26.text: Jesus answered them and said, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, Ye seek me, not because ye saw signs, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were satisfied;

27.text: work not for the food that is perishing, but for the food that is remaining to life age-during, which the Son of Man will give to you, for him did the Father seal — [even] God.'

29.text: Jesus answered and said to them, 'This is the work of God, that ye may believe in him whom He did send.'

32.text: Jesus, therefore, said to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, Moses did not give you the bread out of the heaven; but my Father doth give you the true bread out of the heaven;

33.text: for the bread of God is that which is coming down out of the heaven, and giving life to the world.'

35.text: And Jesus said to them, 'I am the bread of the life; he who is coming unto me may not hunger, and he who is believing in me may not thirst — at any time;

36.text: but I said to you, that ye also have seen me, and ye believe not;

37.text: all that the Father doth give to me will come unto me; and him who is coming unto me, I may in no wise cast without,

38.text: because I have come down out of the heaven, not that I may do my will, but the will of Him who sent me.

39.text: 'And this is the will of the Father who sent me, that all that He hath given to me I may not lose of it, but may raise it up in the last day;

40.text: and this is the will of Him who sent me, that every one who is beholding the Son, and is believing in him, may have life age-during, and I will raise him up in the last day.'

43.text: Jesus answered, therefore, and said to them, 'Murmur not one with another;

44.text: no one is able to come unto me, if the Father who sent me may not draw him, and I will raise him up in the last day;

45.text: it is having been written in the prophets, And they shall be all taught of God; every one therefore who heard from the Father, and learned, cometh to me;

46.text: not that any one hath seen the Father, except he who is from God, he hath seen the Father.

47.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you, He who is believing in me, hath life age-during;

48.text: I am the bread of the life;

49.text: your fathers did eat the manna in the wilderness, and they died;

50.text: this is the bread that out of the heaven is coming down, that any one may eat of it, and not die.

51.text: 'I am the living bread that came down out of the heaven; if any one may eat of this bread he shall live — to the age; and the bread also that I will give is my flesh, that I will give for the life of the world.'

53.text: Jesus, therefore, said to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, If ye may not eat the flesh of the Son of Man, and may not drink his blood, ye have no life in yourselves;

54.text: he who is eating my flesh, and is drinking my blood, hath life age-during, and I will raise him up in the last day;

55.text: for my flesh truly is food, and my blood truly is drink;

56.text: he who is eating my flesh, and is drinking my blood, doth remain in me, and I in him.

57.text: 'According as the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, he also who is eating me, even that one shall live because of me;

58.text: this is the bread that came down out of the heaven; not as your fathers did eat the manna, and died; he who is eating this bread shall live — to the age.'

61.text: And Jesus having known in himself that his disciples are murmuring about this, said to them, 'Doth this stumble you?

62.text: if then ye may behold the Son of Man going up where he was before?

63.text: the spirit it is that is giving life; the flesh doth not profit anything; the sayings that I speak to you are spirit, and they are life;

64.text: but there are certain of you who do not believe;' for Jesus had known from the beginning who they are who are not believing, and who is he who will deliver him up,

65.text: and he said, 'Because of this I have said to you — No one is able to come unto me, if it may not have been given him from my Father.'

67.text: Jesus, therefore, said to the twelve, 'Do ye also wish to go away?'

70.text: Jesus answered them, 'Did not I choose you — the twelve? and of you — one is a devil.

6.text: Jesus, therefore, saith to them, 'My time is not yet present, but your time is always ready;

7.text: the world is not able to hate you, but me it doth hate, because I testify concerning it that its works are evil.

8.text: Ye — go ye up to this feast; I do not yet go up to this feast, because my time hath not yet been fulfilled;'

16.text: Jesus answered them and said, 'My teaching is not mine, but His who sent me;

17.text: if any one may will to do His will, he shall know concerning the teaching, whether it is of God, or — I do speak from myself.

18.text: 'He who is speaking from himself his own glory doth seek, but he who is seeking the glory of him who sent him, this one is true, and unrighteousness is not in him;

19.text: hath not Moses given you the law? and none of you doth the law; why me do ye seek to kill?'

21.text: Jesus answered and said to them, 'One work I did, and ye all wonder,

22.text: because of this, Moses hath given you the circumcision — not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers — and on a sabbath ye circumcise a man;

23.text: if a man doth receive circumcision on a sabbath that the law of Moses may not be broken, are ye wroth with me that I made a man all whole on a sabbath?

24.text: judge not according to appearance, but the righteous judgment judge.'

28.text: Jesus cried, therefore, in the temple, teaching and saying, 'Ye have both known me, and ye have known whence I am; and I have not come of myself, but He who sent me is true, whom ye have not known;

29.text: and I have known Him, because I am from Him, and He did send me.'

33.text: Jesus, therefore, said to them, 'Yet a little time I am with you, and I go away unto Him who sent me;

34.text: ye will seek me, and ye shall not find; and where I am, ye are not able to come.'

37.text: And in the last, the great day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried, saying, 'If any one doth thirst, let him come unto me and drink;

38.text: he who is believing in me, according as the Writing said, Rivers out of his belly shall flow of living water;'

12.text: Again, therefore, Jesus spake to them, saying, 'I am the light of the world; he who is following me shall not walk in the darkness, but he shall have the light of the life.'

21.text: therefore said Jesus again to them, 'I go away, and ye will seek me, and in your sin ye shall die; whither I go away, ye are not able to come.'

23.text: and he said to them, 'Ye are from beneath, I am from above; ye are of this world, I am not of this world;

24.text: I said, therefore, to you, that ye shall die in your sins, for if ye may not believe that I am [he], ye shall die in your sins.'

28.text: Jesus, therefore, said to them, 'When ye may lift up the Son of Man then ye will know that I am [he]; and of myself I do nothing, but according as my Father did teach me, these things I speak;

31.text: Jesus, therefore, said unto the Jews who believed in him, 'If ye may remain in my word, truly my disciples ye are, and ye shall know the truth,

32.text: and the truth shall make you free.'

34.text: Jesus answered them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you — Every one who is committing sin, is a servant of the sin,

36.text: if then the son may make you free, in reality ye shall be free.

51.text: verily, verily, I say to you, If any one may keep my word, death he may not see — to the age.'

56.text: Abraham, your father, was glad that he might see my day; and he saw, and did rejoice.'

58.text: Jesus said to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you, Before Abraham's coming — I am;'

3.text: Jesus answered, 'Neither did this one sin nor his parents, but that the works of God may be manifested in him;

4.text: it behoveth me to be working the works of Him who sent me while it is day; night doth come, when no one is able to work: —

5.text: when I am in the world, I am a light of the world.'

7.text: 'Go away, wash at the pool of Siloam,' which is, interpreted, Sent. He went away, therefore, and did wash, and came seeing;

35.text: Jesus heard that they cast him forth without, and having found him, he said to him, 'Dost thou believe in the Son of God?'

37.text: And Jesus said to him, 'Thou hast both seen him, and he who is speaking with thee is he;'

39.text: And Jesus said, 'For judgment I to this world did come, that those not seeing may see, and those seeing may become blind.'

41.text: Jesus said to them, 'If ye were blind, ye were not having had sin, but now ye say — We see, therefore doth your sin remain.

1.text: 'Verily, verily, I say to you, He who is not entering through the door to the fold of the sheep, but is going up from another side, that one is a thief and a robber;

2.text: and he who is entering through the door is shepherd of the sheep;

3.text: to this one the doorkeeper doth open, and the sheep hear his voice, and his own sheep he doth call by name, and doth lead them forth;

4.text: and when his own sheep he may put forth, before them he goeth on, and the sheep follow him, because they have known his voice;

5.text: and a stranger they will not follow, but will flee from him, because they have not known the voice of strangers.'

7.text: Jesus said therefore again to them, 'Verily, verily, I say to you — I am the door of the sheep;

8.text: all, as many as came before me, are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them;

9.text: I am the door, through me if any one may come in, he shall be saved, and he shall come in, and go out, and find pasture.

10.text: 'The thief doth not come, except that he may steal, and kill, and destroy; I came that they may have life, and may have [it] abundantly.

11.text: 'I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd his life layeth down for the sheep;

12.text: and the hireling, and not being a shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, doth behold the wolf coming, and doth leave the sheep, and doth flee; and the wolf catcheth them, and scattereth the sheep;

13.text: and the hireling doth flee because he is an hireling, and is not caring for the sheep.

14.text: 'I am the good shepherd, and I know my [sheep], and am known by mine,

15.text: according as the Father doth know me, and I know the Father, and my life I lay down for the sheep,

16.text: and other sheep I have that are not of this fold, these also it behoveth me to bring, and my voice they will hear, and there shall become one flock — one shepherd.

17.text: 'Because of this doth the Father love me, because I lay down my life, that again I may take it;

18.text: no one doth take it from me, but I lay it down of myself; authority I have to lay it down, and authority I have again to take it; this command I received from my Father.'
